card.name: Hyphens in UK town lists, ST. before Giles
card.fires_on: Dash separators between capitalised UK town names with postcode codes in brackets, and the period after ST in capitalised headings. Also the start of a capitalised first name such as THOMAS after "friend".

modes.label: Town list dashes
modes.description: The hyphen between entries in an uppercase list of UK towns with postcode area codes.

modes.label: ST. in headings
modes.description: The period after ST in capitalised caption text about St Giles's Church.

modes.label: Capitalised name start
modes.description: The first piece of an all-caps personal name in old text.
modes.example: my young and intelligent friend<< TH>>OMAS LINCOLN, Es
